findings.claim: A non-bare ownership refusal is misclassified as a bare-repository refusal when its quoted directory name contains "cannot use bare repository". With no config anywhere and none named, clean head exits 2 instead of producing the no-repository result required by RH-003.
steps: Create a valid document in a directory literally named cannot use bare repository; assert no symspec.config.json directory entry exists there or in any ancestor.
Run check with no git on PATH.
Run check with an executable git shim printing the standard dubious-ownership first line quoting its working directory, an advice line, and exit 128. It does not print a bare-repository refusal.
